refresh_policy.rationale: Collection uses an owner-created Oura Developer Portal app and scoped API v2 OAuth token. A cached refresh token supports unattended reads; first authorization or a revoked grant requires browser sign-in.

streams.name: sleep
streams.description: Daily sleep sessions and one record per daily sleep score, including score-only days and multiple score documents for one date. A session carries its day's score fields only when that day has exactly one score document. Initial collection covers the most recent 90 days; earlier days require a requested time range.

display.label: Your sleep sessions
display.detail: Per-night: total sleep duration, awake time, stages (REM, deep, light), heart rate range, HRV, temperature deviation, efficiency, latency, timing, and daily score contributors.

streams.name: readiness
streams.description: Daily readiness scores. Initial collection covers the most recent 90 days; earlier days require a requested time range.

display.label: Your readiness
display.detail: Daily readiness score with contributing factors (activity balance, recovery index, HRV balance, etc.).

streams.name: activity
streams.description: Daily activity and movement. Initial collection covers the most recent 90 days; earlier days require a requested time range.

display.label: Your activity
display.detail: Daily steps, active calories, total calories, inactive/low/medium/high activity time, target progress.
